The '''Deathblock''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] block located on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] prison [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tol Ado]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The block was constructed from black-colored metal and was guarded by a detachment of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. In about [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the revolutionary [[Erling Tredway]] was captured by the Empire and interred in the Deathblock.
